name: LiveAgent
one_liner: Customer support helpdesk (QualityUnit) with REST API v3 and built-in MCP server.
auth_notes: API v3 uses apikey header generated by admin in account; OAuth 2.1 only for MCP.
access_notes: Free trial and paid plans from $15/agent/month list price; API v3 key generated in-account. Plan tier restrictions for API not confirmed on fetched official pages (a Portuguese pricing page snippet claims API included in every plan).

buildability.rationale: Self-serve trial account with admin API key and documented v3 API; MCP is per-account.

needs_human_reason: API plan inclusion and endpoint breadth not verified from official fetched pages.

evidence.quote: LiveAgent's API enables seamless software communication

disputes.why: Free trial and in-account admin API key; no sales gate found.
Official liveagent.com and support.liveagent.com consistently describe one product.
